title: Office hours
text: Maple County Human Services is open Monday to Friday, 8:30 to 16:30, and closed on weekends and county holidays. Walk-in intake ends at 15:30.

title: Documents for a SNAP application
text: A SNAP application needs photo ID, proof of income for the last 30 days (such as pay stubs), and proof of address (a lease, rent receipt or utility bill). Caseworkers list anything missing on the case and give the applicant a written due date.

title: Processing times
text: The office aims to decide SNAP applications within 30 days of the application date, and within 7 days when an applicant qualifies for expedited service. Medicaid applications are usually decided within 45 days. A missing document pauses the case until it arrives or the due date passes.

title: Missing documents and reminders
text: When a document is missing, the caseworker sends a written reminder with the due date and offers help getting it. If it is still missing on the due date, the eligibility worker reviews the case before anything is closed. Applicants can ask for more time.

title: Who decides eligibility
text: Only an eligibility worker decides whether a household is eligible, following the program's rules, and a supervisor reviews contested or unusual cases. Assistants and tools may summarize the case record but never make or recommend the decision.

title: Program integrity concerns
text: Staff do not judge whether an applicant is honest. A specific concern, such as income that does not match a document, is referred to the program integrity unit using the referral form, with the facts only. The case continues while the referral is reviewed.

title: Appeals and fair hearings
text: An applicant who disagrees with a decision can ask for a fair hearing within the time stated on the notice. Staff tell applicants how to appeal and never discourage an appeal.

title: Emergency assistance
text: Emergency Assistance helps with an urgent need such as a utility shut-off or eviction notice. A supervisor reviews every emergency payment before it is released; payments waiting for that review are marked held.

title: Language access
text: Applicants can get free interpretation in any language and translated notices in Spanish. Record the preferred language on the applicant's record and book an interpreter before an interview.

title: Confidentiality
text: Case information is shared only with staff who need it for their work and with the applicant. Do not confirm to callers whether someone has a case. Phone numbers and addresses are not shown in the assistant.
